commands.name: config
commands.description: Quick access to server configuration panel - manage all server settings

commands.name: leveling
commands.description: Configure the leveling system for your server
commands.details: Open the leveling configuration for the server. This command requires the Manage Server permission; use the panel to configure the leveling feature.

examples.explanation: Run this command to open the view or perform the action described above.

commands.name: minigames
commands.description: Quick access to minigames configuration - configure guess games and more
commands.details: Open the server configuration for minigames, including the guessing game. This command requires the Manage Server permission.

examples.explanation: Run this command to open the view or perform the action described above.

commands.name: notifications
commands.description: Configure notification settings for your server
commands.details: Open notification settings for the server. This command requires the Manage Server permission.

examples.explanation: Run this command to open the view or perform the action described above.

commands.name: badge
commands.description: Open your badge hub.
commands.details: Open the badge hub to manage your badges through the interactive panel.

examples.explanation: Run this command to open the view or perform the action described above.

descriptionLocalizations.pt-BR: Abra o hub das suas badges.

commands.name: balance
commands.description: Check your current balance.
commands.details: Display your current economy balance. This command provides a quick balance check without requiring an amount or another user.

examples.explanation: Run this command to open the view or perform the action described above.

commands.name: bank
commands.description: Open your bank hub.
commands.details: Open the global bank hub. Use its Deposit or Withdraw controls, then enter the amount in the form. The panel displays the current fees and remaining daily limits; the History view shows transactions.

examples.explanation: Run this command to open the view or perform the action described above.

commands.name: buy
commands.description: Buy an item from the market.
commands.details: Buy an item from the market by selecting its name. The optional amount lets you specify the quantity. Select an autocomplete suggestion to identify the item.

examples.explanation: Replace the values in angle brackets with your own selections before running this command.

commands.name: chop
commands.description: Chop trees to earn monies and items.
commands.details: Perform a woodcutting action to earn currency and items. Check the response for the result of the action and use `/cooldowns` to inspect economy cooldowns.

examples.explanation: Run this command to open the view or perform the action described above.

descriptionLocalizations.pt-BR: Corte arvores para ganhar moedas e itens.

commands.name: cooldowns
commands.description: View cooldowns for basic economy commands.
commands.details: Display cooldown information for basic economy actions. Consult this view when an action is unavailable because it was used recently.

examples.explanation: Run this command to open the view or perform the action described above.

descriptionLocalizations.pt-BR: Veja os cooldowns basicos da economia.

commands.name: cosmetics
commands.description: Browse and equip your unlocked cosmetics.
commands.details: Open the cosmetics panel to browse unlocked cosmetics and equip a selection.

examples.explanation: Run this command to open the view or perform the action described above.

descriptionLocalizations.pt-BR: Veja e equipe seus cosmeticos desbloqueados.

commands.name: crates
commands.description: Shows your crate inventory and quick-open buttons.
commands.details: Display your crate inventory and the quick-open controls. To select a crate directly by name, use `/opencrate`.

examples.explanation: Run this command to open the view or perform the action described above.

commands.name: daily
commands.description: Claim your daily reward.
commands.details: Claim your daily economy reward. If the reward is on cooldown, the response explains when it becomes available again.

examples.explanation: Run this command to open the view or perform the action described above.

commands.name: equip
commands.description: Equip a tool.
commands.details: Equip a tool by selecting its name. Use autocomplete to choose the tool; use `/unequip` to remove a tool from a slot.

examples.explanation: Replace the values in angle brackets with your own selections before running this command.

commands.name: fish
commands.description: Fish to earn monies and items.
commands.details: Perform a fishing action to earn currency and items. Check the response for the action result and `/cooldowns` for economy cooldown information.

examples.explanation: Run this command to open the view or perform the action described above.

descriptionLocalizations.pt-BR: Pesque para ganhar moedas e itens.

commands.name: gacha
commands.description: Open the Stable Crate hub.
commands.details: Open the Stable Crate hub. This command starts an interactive flow rather than accepting a banner or draw amount as a slash-command argument. `/scout` opens the featured banner directly.

examples.explanation: Run this command to open the view or perform the action described above.

descriptionLocalizations.pt-BR: Abra o hub principal do Stable Crate.

commands.name: inventory
commands.description: View your inventory.
commands.details: Display your economy inventory. Use the inventory to check available items before selecting a command such as `/use`, `/equip` or `/sell`.

examples.explanation: Run this command to open the view or perform the action described above.

commands.name: loot
commands.description: Search for loot and earn some items or monies.
commands.details: Search for loot to earn items or currency. Consult the action response for the result and `/cooldowns` for cooldown information.

examples.explanation: Run this command to open the view or perform the action described above.

descriptionLocalizations.pt-BR: Procure saque e ganhe itens ou moedas.

commands.description: Mine to earn monies and items.

commands.name: opencrate
commands.description: Open a crate using crate keys.
commands.details: Open a crate selected by name using crate keys. The amount defaults to one and cannot exceed five crates in a single request. Use autocomplete to select the crate.

examples.explanation: Replace the values in angle brackets with your own selections before running this command.

commands.name: scout
commands.description: Open the featured Stable Crate banner.
commands.details: Open the featured Stable Crate banner directly. For the main Stable Crate hub, use `/gacha`.

examples.explanation: Run this command to open the view or perform the action described above.

descriptionLocalizations.pt-BR: Abra diretamente o banner em destaque do Stable Crate.

commands.name: sell
commands.description: Sell an item to the market.
commands.details: Sell a market item selected by name. The optional amount specifies the quantity to sell; use autocomplete to select the item.

examples.explanation: Replace the values in angle brackets with your own selections before running this command.

commands.name: unequip
commands.description: Unequip a tool slot.
commands.details: Remove the equipped tool from a selected slot. The slot argument refers to a pick, axe, rod or wrench slot rather than an arbitrary inventory item.

options.description: Tool slot: pick, axe, rod, wrench

commands.name: use
commands.description: Use consumable items.
commands.details: Run `/use item` with a consumable item selected by name. The optional amount applies when the item supports using multiple units. The item must be usable and available in your inventory. SR Badge Selector vouchers are used one at a time and open a badge selection panel.

examples.explanation: Replace the values in angle brackets with your own selections before running this command.

commands.description: Open your workbench hub.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Management: Access creative tools for server management
commands.details: Run `/create menu` to open the creative tools for server management. The menu offers flows such as the Embed Creator, Forum Creator and reaction roles. The command requires Manage Messages; advanced settings can require additional permissions.

examples.explanation: Run this command to open the view or perform the action described above.

commands.name: guess
commands.description: Start a new guess game round in the configured guess channel
commands.details: Start a guessing-game round in the configured guess channel. Configure the game through `/minigames` before starting rounds.

examples.explanation: Run this command to open the view or perform the action described above.

commands.name: umacards
commands.description: View Uma Musume Support Cards
commands.details: Browse Uma Musume Support Cards. The optional search accepts an English or Japanese character name or a card ID. Without a search, the bot opens the card browser. Levels range from 1 to 50; the bot selects the nearest supported level when needed. Supported levels are 1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45 and 50.

examples.explanation: Run this command to open the view or perform the action described above.

options.name: search
options.description: Search by character name (EN/JP) or card ID
